name: class-toolkit
description: Generate personalised educational resources for each student in the class

hooks.command: node -e "try{require('child_process').execSync('pandoc --version',{stdio:'ignore'})}catch(e){process.exit(1)}" || echo "[class-toolkit] pandoc is not installed. The generate-resource skill requires pandoc to create Word documents. Install from: https://pandoc.org/installing.html"
